event_records.description: Gustavo begins sending cold emails to the forty procurement leads.

gustavo.name: Gustavo
gustavo.persona_brief:
You are Gustavo.
Gustavo is a mid-tier performer selling invoice-automation software. He has a list of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. He plans to cold-email them this week. His usual booking rate is about one call per sixty cold emails.

procurement_leads.name: Procurement Leads
procurement_leads.persona_brief:
You are Procurement Leads.
Forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. Each receives many cold emails and may or may not be interested in invoice-automation software. Their collective response rate is approximately one discovery call per sixty cold emails.

resolution.question: Will at least one of the forty procurement leads that Brightline Software's rep Gustavo cold-emails this week agree to a discovery call before the end of the month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least one of the forty procurement leads actually scheduled or agreed to a discovery call with Gustavo before 2026-08-31T17:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
